headline: US Moves to Remove South Africa and Rwanda from AGOA Trade Pact
summary: US President Donald Trump has notified Congress of his intention to remove South Africa and Rwanda from a preferential trade programme starting January 1, 2027.
why: Changes to preferential trade agreements like the African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA) can alter export volumes, tariffs, and cross-border commercial ties for developing nations.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Removal from a preferential trade program could negatively affect export competitiveness.
